commands.review_summary:
The PR adds `wacli sync --presence-mode normal|quiet`, threads it into initial sync connect and sync event presence sends, updates docs, and adds presence-mode tests.

Reproducibility: yes. for the blocking review finding: source inspection shows quiet mode reaches initial connect and event presence sends, but follow-mode reconnect still calls the lower-level client with default connect options. I did not run a live WhatsApp sync because this review is read-only.

target.title: feat(sync): add quiet presence mode
target.body:
## Summary

- Add `wacli sync --presence-mode normal|quiet`, defaulting to `normal`.
- Preserve current sync presence behaviour by default.
- In `quiet` mode, suppress available presence on authenticated connect, connect events, and push-name updates while still sending unavailable presence on cleanup.
- Document the personal mirror use case and add presence-mode tests.

## Why

Long-running `sync --follow` sessions can keep the linked device globally available. For personal-number mirror deployments, that can interfere with primary phone notification behaviour. Quiet mode gives operators an explicit opt-in that avoids available-presence updates without weakening the existing cleanup safety.

## Testing

- `CGO_ENABLED=1 CGO_CFLAGS="-Wno-error=missing-braces" go test -tags sqlite_fts5 ./internal/app ./internal/wa ./cmd/wacli`
- `pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build` in an unprivileged copy at `/tmp/wacli-gate`
- Built `./dist/wacli` and ran a redacted live one-shot sync against an authenticated personal mirror store with quiet mode:

```text
$ ./dist/wacli --store REDACTED --events sync --once --idle-exit 5s --max-reconnect 30s --presence-mode quiet --max-messages 50000 --max-db-size 1GB
Messages stored: 0
{"event":"connected","ts":1783595268235}
{"event":"idle_exit","data":{"idle_duration":"5s","messages_synced":0},"ts":1783595273510}

$ ./dist/wacli --json --store REDACTED doctor
{"lock_held":false,"authenticated":true,"connected":false,"connection_state":"disconnected"}
```

Note: the same full gate fails when run as root in `/root/clawd/repos/wacli` because `internal/fsutil` correctly expects chmod `0500` to be non-writable, but root can still write. The unprivileged run passes.

Closes #297
